findings.currency: always the base_currency of the manifest
findings.amount: absolute value in minor units of the base currency, taken from the carrier row
findings.evidence: cite at least one ID of every evidence group; at most 10 IDs; every ID must exist in the public tables (row_id, doc_id, invoice_id, payment_id, fx id)

extra_posting.carrier: Dr 1200 of the extra issuing entry

duplicate_document.carrier: Dr 1200 of the entry of one copy

evidence: a row of each issuing entry

payment_allocation.carrier: expected AR relief (1200) by this payment minus the actual relief
evidence: a row of the invoice issuing entry

fx_conversion.carrier: |Dr 1200 - conv(total, correct rate)| or |Dr 1010 - conv(amount, correct rate)|
evidence: the fx row of the correct rate

period_cutoff.carrier: Dr 1200 of the shifted invoice entry, or Dr 1010 + Dr 6100 of the shifted receipt entry
evidence: a row of the shifted entry
